description: NaMg₆LaO₈ is Caswellsilverite-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.21 Å) and four longer (2.26 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Mg-O bond lengths are 2.26 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.26 Å) and two longer (2.28 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.53 Å. La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.26 Å) and two longer (2.34 Å) La-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, four equivalent Mg, and one La atom to form ONaLaMg₄ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ONaLaMg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. In the second O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaLaMg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Mg and two equivalent La atoms to form OLa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OLa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaLaMg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OLa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaLaMg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OLa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaLaMg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both O-Mg bond lengths are 2.02 Å.
